tips.text: The UK government tells British travellers that visits to Schengen countries in the 180 days before they travel count towards their 90 days, and that a trip that also takes in other Schengen countries must stay within the 90-day visa-free limit as a whole.

Hungary's currency is the forint (HUF). Canada's travel advice says euros are accepted in Budapest and some other major cities where a sign is posted, that rates may not be very competitive, and warns against unofficial moneychangers.

In Hungary, Canada's travel advice says to use only officially marked taxis, to call one through a dispatcher rather than hailing it on the street, and to make sure the meter is on and shows the correct rate. It reports overcharging by taxi drivers, and that some drivers take part in bar and restaurant bill scams, so do not ask them to recommend bars or clubs.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Hungary?
faq.answer: No. US passport holders can visit Hungary and the rest of the Schengen Area visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Once ETIAS starts, they will need to obtain this online authorization (€20) before travel.

faq.question: How much does a Hungary Schengen visa cost?
faq.answer: The Schengen short-stay visa costs €90 for adults and €45 for children aged 6–11. It allows stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period across all Schengen countries. The Visa Code says applications are decided within 15 calendar days, a period that may be extended to a maximum of 45 calendar days in individual cases.

faq.question: Does Hungary use the euro?
faq.answer: No. Hungary uses the Hungarian forint (HUF). Canada's travel advice says euros are accepted in Budapest and some other major cities where a sign is posted, but that the rates may not be competitive.

faq.question: Is ETIAS required to enter Hungary?
faq.answer: ETIAS for visa-exempt travelers is not yet in operation, and no applications are being collected; the EU will announce the start date several months before launch. Once ETIAS starts, the €20 online authorization will be required before travel.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Hungary without a visa?
faq.answer: Nationals of the countries on the EU's visa-exempt list can stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period. The UK government tells British travellers that visits to Schengen countries in the 180 days before they travel count towards their 90 days.
